title: Fleet Rung 42 — THE MULTI-NETWORK VAULT: the vault holds what its keys can move and sees every network. The owner demanded a smart thing on our network that holds real coins/tokens of all networks and ours — "לעשות משהו חכם על הרשת שלנו שתוכל להחזיק מטבעות אמיתיים טוקנים של כל הרשתות וגם שלנו כמובן". R42 lands it in dex-core.cjs v1.2.0: CUSTODY-CLASS LAW — what the vault may count as ITS OWN: MEASURED-KEYED (active key material in the protected desks + chain-measured balance → custody, the ONLY mintable class; STEEM/SBD today), OBSERVED-POST-KEYED (posting key held — account controlled, transfers gated; BLURT), OBSERVED-UNCONTROLLED (the name exists on the chain but its active pub ≠ any held key — the R38 law; HIVE/HBD), PLANNED-NO-CLAIM (SAOS), OBSERVED-ABSENT (probe failed — honest unknown). The OBSERVED registry: HIVE/HBD/BLURT probed KEYLESSLY every tick via condenser RPCs (api.steemit.com / api.hive.blog+openhive / blurt-rpc.saboin.com+2 fallbacks) and booked with node provenance — the vault SEES every network, holds only what its keys can move, and the class upgrades the same tick verified key material appears (no new code). ISSUER IDENTITY (SAOS-DEX-ISSUER/1 — R11's corridor landed): a stable recomputable sha256-16 identity over the wrapper set + chain bindings + pool catalog; the mint law (1:1 against MEASURED-KEYED custody only, 25% of measured keyed custody per wrapper — the deterministic genesis law) and the per-chain peg-out corridors hang off it. REDEEM LAW (the real-value law's second half): burn BEFORE payout — the in-ledger redeem is ALWAYS honored 1:1 (minted/reserve/claims move together, conservation asserted); the chain-side payout is QUEUED to dex/pegout-queue.json with its corridor named — a keyed desk owns the broadcast, keyless code never fires one (STEEM/SBD = KEYED-DESK; HIVE/HBD = PLAN-PEGOUT-KEYED-OPERATOR; BLURT = PLAN-PEGOUT-KEYED-OPERATOR, posting key only). Redeem requests are consumed single-writer by the tick from dex/redeem-requests.json (atomic tmp+rename, refusals booked: DUST / OVER-MINT / UNKNOWN-WRAPPER / INSUFFICIENT-CLAIM). POOL CATALOG P5-P9 appended to the live book by the deterministic reconcile law (never reorders, idempotent, born empty): P5 WHIVE/HIVE, P6 WHBD/HBD, P7 WBLURT/BLURT (pegs), P8 HIVE/STEEM (the cross-network bridge pair, planned — arms when HIVE key material verifies), P9 WSBD/WHBD (the SBD↔HBD dollar bridge). CROSS-FAIR LAW: HIVE-per-STEEM = the cross of the router anchors (SBD-per-STEEM ÷ HBD-per-HIVE — the dollar pegs are the shared unit), BigInt floor, honest nulls; booked in the feed row and the A2 arb row (NO-CUSTODY until armed — honest band).
